Partial<Type>.description:
TS 2.1
Partial<Type>
Makes every property of `Type` optional — handy for patch/update-style function parameters.

Required<Type>.description:
TS 2.8
Required<Type>
Makes every property of `Type` required, stripping any `?` optionality.

Readonly<Type>.description:
TS 2.1
Readonly<Type>
Makes every property of `Type` read-only, so reassigning any of them is a compile-time error.

Record<Keys, Type>.description:
TS 2.1
Record<Keys, Type>
Constructs an object type whose keys are `Keys` and whose values are all `Type` — a typed dictionary/map.

Pick<Type, Keys>.description:
TS 2.1
Pick<Type, Keys>
Constructs a type by keeping only the given subset of `Type`'s properties.

Omit<Type, Keys>.description:
TS 3.5
Omit<Type, Keys>
Constructs a type by removing the given subset of `Type`'s properties — the inverse of `Pick`.

Exclude<UnionType, ExcludedMembers>.description:
TS 2.8
Exclude<UnionType, ExcludedMembers>
Removes from `UnionType` every member assignable to `ExcludedMembers`.

Extract<Type, Union>.description:
TS 2.8
Extract<Type, Union>
Keeps from `Type` only the members assignable to `Union` — the inverse of `Exclude`.

ReturnType<Type>.description:
TS 2.8
ReturnType<Type>
Extracts a function type's return type — commonly written as `ReturnType<typeof fn>` to derive it from an existing value.

Parameters<Type>.description:
TS 3.1
Parameters<Type>
Extracts a function type's parameter types as a tuple.

Awaited<Type>.description:
TS 4.5
Awaited<Type>
Recursively unwraps a `Promise` (or thenable) type to the type it resolves to — models what `await` does at the type level.

InstanceType<Type>.description:
TS 2.8
InstanceType<Type>
Extracts the instance type produced by a class constructor type.

ConstructorParameters<Type>.description:
TS 3.1
ConstructorParameters<Type>
Extracts a class constructor's parameter types as a tuple.

ThisType<Type>.description:
TS 2.3
ThisType<Type>
A marker (no properties) used inside an object-literal type to set what `this` refers to within its methods — mainly used by object-literal-with-methods factory helpers.

string manipulation types.description:
TS 4.1
Uppercase/Lowercase/Capitalize/Uncapitalize<StringType>
Intrinsic string-literal-type transforms, most often used together with template literal types.
